_comment: Recorded from THE BUDLUM DIREKTIF (version 1.0, 2026-11-04) when that document was read.
The directive does not enter the tree (section 0.1 item 5), so this file is the
machine-readable form of the three tables the ledgers under docs/ are built from:
section 15.7 and the section 15.8 cards (one record per work package), section 18
(one record per Testnet Launch Gate item) and sections 14.3 to 14.6 (one record per
finding: BLG-001 to BLG-267 and the 44 archive records).
Titles and requirement statements are English because the tree is English (section
0.1 item 5). The subject text of a finding stays in the directive; this file carries
the identifiers a ledger is counted by. Severity tokens S1, S2 and S3 in the archive
tables are recorded as Critical, High and Medium.
Nothing here is a status. Status is measured by ops/scripts/live_audit.py.

tlg.requirement: No Critical or High finding is open. A finding that stays open is covered by a feature closed on the testnet, and a test proves the closure.
Every Closed or Conditionally closed feature of section 1.5 passes its `<feature>_is_closed_on_testnet` test.
No legacy storage code remains in the tree.
The B.U.D. 3.0 acceptance tests pass: T1 to T12, T14 to T26 and T34 to T41. The nightly tests T3, T4, T6, T7 and T17 passed on each of the last 7 nights.
The committee finality and seat handover tests pass (section 7.12).
The instant duty handover tests and the churn simulation pass.
Rehearsal drill T-1 passed: every Mobile validator left at once, the finality latency did not change and no object was lost.
Rehearsal drill T-2 passed: 10 percent of the Full validators left at once and finality lagged at most 2 checkpoints.
Rehearsal drills T-3, T-4, T-5 and T-7 passed.
At least 20 real Android phones served as validators in the rehearsal: they stored content, answered audits, served symbols and were rewarded.
The device matrix results exist: 24 hour service, battery budget and the NAT matrix.
The EVM, WASM (CosmWasm ABI), SVM, Move (Aptos) and BudZero conformance suites pass 100 percent, or every exception sits in the limits table.
The tool tests passed in the nightly workflow with no code change: Foundry, Hardhat, viem, ethers, CosmJS, Anchor, solana CLI, @solana/web3.js, aptos CLI and the Aptos TypeScript SDK.
One EVM contract calls one CosmWasm contract in the same transaction and the result is atomic. Rehearsal drill T-6 passed.
The cross-architecture root equality check passes.
The gas calibration criterion is met.
The genesis ceremony rehearsal passed, the supply audit is green and at least 8 Full validators took part.
NAT traversal: the relay, DCUtR and AutoNAT nightlies pass, and the rehearsal records the relay, hole punch and direct connection ratios.
Economics: the pool split, the storage fee and the rewards preserve supply and `economy_invariants` passes.
RPC: the listener rules, the method tables and the rate limits pass, and rehearsal drill T-7 passed.
The faucet, the explorer, the dashboards and the alerts ran in the rehearsal.
The independent reviews are complete and their new Critical and High findings are closed.
README.md equals Appendix A and README.tr.md equals Appendix B. The definition blocks are byte for byte identical, no placeholder remains, and every number comes from CI or the rehearsal output.
The concept-name gate is green in absolute mode.
CI is green and every nightly workflow passed on each of the last 7 nights.
The release artifacts are reproducible and the SBOM and the signatures are published.
The bridge decision and the AI layer decision are written in the TLG report and proven by a test.
